subject: MPA close plan — security gates, DPA redlines, retention & rollback criteria
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@crestbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CrestBank Legal <legal@crestbank.com>
Date: 2027-07-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MPA & security gate timeline — CrestBank evaluation

Marcus — thanks again for the demo yesterday. The procurement and security teams reviewed the product brief and want to firm up the Mutual Action Plan so we can lock a Q3 pilot start. Two things we need clarified before the next exec sync:

1) SOC 2 evidence surface — can you map which artifacts you can provide vs. which require our SOC vendor to validate? We need an inventory and ETA.
2) DPA + data retention — we have a standard retention requirement of 7 years for transaction metadata and 18 months for non-transactional logs. Will Redwood accept those retention windows, or will we need an escrow/archival carveout?

Attached is a stub SIG/CAIQ that our security team started (CrestBank_SIG_matrix.xlsx). Also flagging legal — any immediate DPA redlines we should expect?

Target: CrestBank would like MPA acceptance + signed DPA by 2027-08-06 to begin pilot onboarding 2027-09-01. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. PM, Cloud Strategy
CrestBank

Attachments: CrestBank_SIG_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@crestbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & security gate timeline — CrestBank evaluation

Elena — great to hear and thanks for the clear dates. High-level response and a proposed split of responsibilities inside the MPA so we can hit 2027-08-06: 

Quick answers up front: we can commit to providing a SOC 2 artifact inventory and a scoped evidence intake by 2027-07-23. For retention, Redwood supports configurable retention per-customer and residency options; the 7-year transaction metadata window is atypical but possible via an archival tier — we should capture any escrow or long-tail archival in the MPA as a priced item.

Proposed MPA tasks (short list we can turn into the shared spreadsheet):
- Redwood: deliver SOC 2 artifact index + sample evidence links (owner: Neha) — due 2027-07-23
- CrestBank: sign SIG/CAIQ gaps or accept open items (owner: Elena) — due 2027-07-26
- Redwood Legal: provide initial DPA redline, note residency controls & KMS options (owner: Kimberly) — due 2027-07-24
- Joint: finalize DPA + execute (owner: CrestBank Legal + Redwood Legal) — target 2027-08-06
- Ops: confirm data retention escrow approach and cost estimate (owner: Marcus) — deliver 2027-07-28

If those milestones work I’ll put them into the MPA and create a single action tracker with owners and dates. I’ll also drop a short evidence intake CSV (SOC2-evidence-plan.csv) so your security team can quickly map items to CrestBank controls.

One ask: If CrestBank’s legal expects the 7-year retention hard-coded in the DPA, can you confirm whether that applies to PII-enriched artifacts or only transaction IDs/metadata? That will determine whether we route data to an isolated archival store (adds time/cost).

I’ll start the DPA redline in parallel and flag any non-standard carveouts.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-plan.csv (csv, 6KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: CrestBank Legal <legal@crestbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-17T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & security gate timeline — DPA redlines (initial)

Hi Elena / team — looping in Redwood Legal on the MPA thread. Quick notes from our side on the DPA and a couple of redlines you should expect in the draft I’ll circulate: 

1) Data retention: Redwood supports customer-configurable retention and can commit to storing transaction metadata for 7 years if CrestBank is prepared to accept an archival escrow clause (we will move archived records to a cold store in the EU if residency required). We will add a cost appendix for archival storage and retrieval SLAs — this keeps the base hosted offering within standard pricing.

2) PII vs metadata: Our standard DPA treats transaction metadata (non-PII attributes) separately from PII. If CrestBank confirms PII enrichment is required, we will need to scope the PII processing controls (e.g., anonymization, purge workflows).

3) SIG/CAIQ: I reviewed your matrix and added comments inline. We can close ~75% of the items with artifacts; the remainder are operational (e.g., DR runbooks, background-check attestations) that we can schedule proof-of-evidence for during pilot onboarding.

4) Rollback / escape hatch: Suggest we put a formal rollback criterion into the MPA: if critical vulnerabilities are discovered during the pilot or if a Level 1 SOC issue is raised that cannot be mitigated within 14 days, CrestBank may suspend ingest and Redwood will escrow the session data in read-only storage until remediation. This protects both sides operationally.

I’ll attach an initial redline (Redlined_DPA_marcus-20270716.docx) and a short comment doc for the SIG entries. Please confirm whether legal prefers DocuSign flow or countersign via email.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redlined_DPA_marcus-20270716.docx (docx, 42KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@crestbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MPA & security gate timeline — SOC 2 evidence intake and pilot acceptance criteria

Elena / team — attaching a compact acceptance checklist (inline below) and owners for the SOC2/evidence path. I’ll own the artifact index and provide links to sample evidence by 2027-07-23.

Proposed SOC2 / acceptance checklist (pilot):
- SOC2 artifact index delivered (Neha) — 2027-07-23
- SIG matrix reviewed and annotated (Elena) — 2027-07-26
- DPA signed or countersigned (Kimberly + CrestBank Legal) — 2027-08-06
- Pilot ingress smoke test (security & ops) — 2027-09-01 to 2027-09-03
- Final go/no-go decision (CrestBank execs + Redwood) — 2027-09-10

Evidence intake notes:
- We will provide S3 links to redacted SOC2 reports (read-only). For operational items (background checks, DR runbooks) we will either provide screenshots or schedule a short runbook walkthrough with your security team.
- For 7-year transaction metadata archival, the preferred pattern is: production hot store (90 days) -> warm tier (up to 18 months) -> cold archival (7+ years) with retrieval SLA of 72 hours. Archival storage is billed separately; I’ll provide a cost estimate by 2027-07-28.

Rollback / critical acceptance items:
- Critical CRITICAL findings in penetration test that cannot be mitigated within 14 days = auto-suspend ingest + evidence escrow.
- Failure of scheduled DR test during pilot = remediation plan within 10 business days or pilot pause.

Next steps: Marcus — if you can spin the MPA spreadsheet with the rows above I’ll fill the evidence columns and attach sample artifact links. Elena — if CrestBank Legal can confirm whether the 7-year retention is required for PII or metadata-only, we’ll finalize the archival appendix before your signature deadline.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-plan.csv (csv, 6KB)
